display.purpose: The home hero wordmark only, once per page. BLND variation axis is driven live by today's AQI level.

title.purpose: Card titles, popup headers, panel intros.

body.purpose: Nav links, card copy, table cells, form fields.

label.purpose: Tracked uppercase chrome: chips, filters, table headers.

shadows.name: elevated-card
shadows.purpose: The one shadow recipe in the app, used only by surfaces that visually float above other content: the map's glass filter chrome (reused as-is on the Symptoms page), symptom severity cards, home sensor cards, and the archive row-preview card. Always paired with rounded.card (20px) — see the 'One-Elevation Rule'.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: The single interaction timing used across the entire interface — hover and active states on nav, buttons, and rows.

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Topbar navigation item — uppercase, tracked, transparent at rest.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Epilogue', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1A1A1A; text-decoration: none; padding: 0 28px; display: flex; align-items: center; height: 100%; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.active { color: #B7410E; }

components.name: Pollutant Chip
components.description: Small bordered tag pairing a pollutant name with its current value; clickable to retarget charts.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; padding: 5px 6px; border: 1.5px solid #DDDAD3; background: #FAF8F7; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Epilogue', sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #DDDAD3; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B7410E; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip-name { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #9B9790; } .ds-chip-val { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #1A1A1A; }

components.name: Sensor Card
components.description: Per-sensor unit reused across Home, Map, and Archive — name, location, current reading.
components.css: .ds-sensor-card { background: #FAF8F7; color: #1A1A1A; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px; font-family: 'Epilogue', sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sensor-card:hover { background: #DDDAD3; } .ds-sensor-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #B7410E; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sensor-name { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-sensor-sub { font-size: 11px; color: #9B9790; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: The worst-pollutant-wins AQI indicator — a solid fill from the six-step status scale, never averaged.
components.css: .ds-status-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Epilogue', sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #1A1A1A; }

components.name: Footer Band
components.description: The one place the accent color fills rather than accents — carries the bilingual 'simulated data' disclaimer.
components.html: Aria Bene Comune — Linux Group TarantoDati simulati a scopo dimostrativo
components.css: .ds-footer { background: #B7410E; color: #FAF8F7; padding: 16px 24px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; font-family: 'Epilogue', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Elevated Card
components.description: The one rounded/shadowed exception to the square-corners doctrine — any surface that visually floats above a map, a photo, or another card: the map's filter/sensor-list/detail-panel chrome (glass, translucent, reused as-is for the Symptoms page's filter panel), symptom severity cards and home sensor cards (solid backgrounds — status color and paper respectively), and the archive table's row-preview card. Same radius and shadow token pair everywhere; only the background material changes.
components.css: .ds-elevated-card { border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05), 0 0 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.16), 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.16); font-family: 'Epilogue', sans-serif; padding: 16px 20px; } .ds-elevated-card--glass { background: linear-gradient(165deg, rgba(250,248,246,0.85) 0%, rgba(250,248,246,0.6) 100%); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(1.9); } .ds-elevated-card--solid { background: #FAF8F7; } .ds-elevated-card-label { font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9B9790; }

narrative.overview: This isn't a lab printout — it's a neighbor telling you the truth about the air outside, in words you don't need a degree to act on. Plain, warm language carries the page: a reading is never just a number, it's what to actually do about it. The precision is real and sits underneath — the six-step hazard scale, the WHO-anchored NO2 thresholds, the worst-pollutant-wins logic — but it never gets to talk over the plain language on top of it. Square corners, an off-white paper ground instead of stark white, and a single restrained accent keep the frame quiet so the warmth in the words and the honesty in the color scale can carry the page. What this explicitly is not: a corporate SaaS analytics product, and not a government or bureaucratic portal — the citizen ownership has to be legible in the feel, not just stated in a footer.
keyCharacteristics: Off-white paper ground (#FAF8F7), never stark white
A separate six-step hazard scale does all the alarming; never bleeds into the neutral palette
Every corner is square (0px) except elevated cards, which are always exactly rounded.card (20px)
Bilingual (IT/EN) from a single flag, not a bolted-on translation layer
One expressive typeface (Ronzino Variable) reserved for exactly one line per page

rules.name: The Worst-Pollutant Rule
rules.body: A sensor's color is always the single worst-scoring pollutant out of the eight tracked, never an average.

rules.name: The One-Accent Rule
rules.body: Brick is the only saturated color allowed outside the status scale.

rules.name: The One-Word Rule
rules.body: Ronzino Variable appears exactly once per page — the hero wordmark. Every other character is Epilogue.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No shadows anywhere text or layout chrome lives. Depth there is a solid fill or a hairline border, never a blur.

rules.name: The One-Elevation Rule
rules.body: Every surface that does get a shadow — map filter chrome, symptom cards, home sensor cards, the archive row-preview card — uses the exact same recipe (rounded.card + the shared elevated-card shadow). A fourth floating surface reuses this token pair rather than inventing new numbers.

dos: Do let the six-step status scale be the only saturated color on any given screen.
Do keep every corner square (0px) unless it's an elevated card, which is always rounded.card (20px).
Do pair every reading with what to actually do about it.
Do keep the WHO-vs-legal gap on screen, not filed under a footnote.
Do write body copy plain and warm first.
donts: Don't build toward a corporate SaaS analytics look.
Don't let it read as a government or bureaucratic portal.
Don't average AQI levels across pollutants.
Don't add drop shadows or elevation to page/text/layout chrome — elevated cards are the sole exception, and they all share one shadow recipe.
Don't introduce a second expressive typeface.
